scripts.vercel-build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('next-app/package.json')){ cp.execSync('cd next-app && npm install && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('next-app/package.json')){ cp.execSync('cd next-app && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { cp.execSync('next build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
